description: Map the professional graph around a target company. Finds senior decision-makers at the account, pulls each target's recent posts/reactions/comments to identify engagers, then scores every connection and produces a prioritized outreach queue. Credit cost scales with targets — bounded by `max_targets`. Max spend per call is ~175 credits; actual cost is reported in the response.

max_targets.description: Max targets to deep-map per account (1-20, default 5). Each target adds ~3 credits.

title_keywords.description: Title keywords to filter targets. Default: ['VP','Director','Head of','Chief']

name: map_constellation
